response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_avg FROM per_status) SELECT p.healtheval, p.total_scancount, p.avg_gb_per_min, p.avg_gb_per_min - m.mean_avg AS gap_from_mean FROM per_status p CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
